messages:
priya: Heads-up — planned v3.2 rollout in ~20m across US / EU / APAC. Change window 01:00-03:00 UTC. APAC warm pool looks tight; need quick capacity check and rollback plan. If APAC < 6 GPUs we hold canary there and continue US/EU. Ping @mike @santiago for numbers and any objections.

deploy-bot: preflight checklist: 
• deploy window: 01:00-03:00 UTC
• canary slices: US-1 (5%), EU-1 (5%), APAC-1 (5%)
• auto-rollback: enabled on 5xx spike or latency > 2.5s for 3m
• run `./scripts/warmup_pool --region apac` (status below)

mike: APAC warm-pool currently at 4 GPUs (2 reserved, 2 idle). We can borrow 2 from test cluster (adds 2) but that requires 15m lead time. Current sustained token QPS spike in APAC right now ~18% above baseline.
santiago: Confirming what Mike said. Also seeing higher KV cache eviction rate on apac-gpu-3 (logs: `kv_evictions: 213 -> 412 last 30m`). Not ideal for a canary.
ben: +1 to holding APAC canary. Suggest we pin APAC routing to v3.1 for the window and keep v3.2 in US/EU. That reduces blast radius and matches customer SLAs.
alexa: If we pin APAC, we should flip the routing policy to `region: prefer-stable` and enable `burst-protect` for 30m post-deploy. Can do with one config change: ```yaml
routing:
  apac:
    policy: prefer-stable
    burst_protect: true
```
ops-bot: alert: apac region 1-min CPU spike at 00:32 UTC, +22% sustained. No infra failures yet.
priya: Ok decision summary: Proceed with US/EU canaries, APAC pinned to v3.1 for this window. Mike — start borrow request for +2 GPUs from test cluster and try to warm them asap; if ready within 15m we can re-evaluate a later APAC sweep in the window. If not, leave APAC pinned and roll forward tomorrow during extended window.
mike: Request filed to test infra team (ticket #INF-4192). ETA 12m. I'll post when warm pool hits >=6.
santiago: I'll watch KV eviction and tracer for any regression in US/EU during canary. If `kv_evictions` or `p95_latency` crosses thresholds we'll hit rollback.
ben: I'll update the release notes / changelog to note APAC pinned and add rollback instructions under "Operational runbook".
alexa: Also adding a temporary rate cap in APAC routing: `rate_cap: 0.8` to reduce pressure if we see surges.
priya: Thanks all. Post-deploy checklist: monitor deploy-bot channel for auto-rollback, manual abort if any error spike. Will follow up in 30m with final go/no-go. :thumbsup:
deploy-bot: deploy scheduled: us/eu canary start in 18m. APAC pinned to v3.1. Auto-rollback hooks armed.
ops-bot: note: keeping smoke test runners on APAC for extra 10m after any config change.
priya: Copy. If warm pool hits >=6 before 00:50 UTC, we'll attempt APAC micro-canary with 2% traffic. Otherwise proceed next maintenance window.
ben: A quick note for customer success: I'll add a blurb to release notes and notify the top 5 APAC accounts of pinning.
priya: Closing loop — thanks. I'll post a short postmortem if anything goes sideways.
